title: Tech Note: Enhanced Print form Capabilities in 6.8.1

historical_commentary.text: 4D's Print Form command and its procedural printing capabilities have continued to be developed and supported in current 4D, so the underlying capability remains still relevant, though the specific 6.8.1-era feature set and its perceived reputation issues are now a historical footnote rather than a live developer concern.
related_updates: 4D's Print Form and related printing commands have continued to be maintained and extended in versions since 6.8.1
